sources.citation: The Rosetta Project. n.d. [uploaded 2010]. Laeko-Libuat Swadesh List (lkl). Internet Archive item rosettaproject_lkl_swadesh-1, file 10 glosses, two transcriptions each; source not stated, evidently keyed from Laycock 1968). CC-BY 3.0.
sources.note: Wordlist-only data, no statement. All ten items carry an acute accent in one of the two transcriptions, always on the first syllable of the root (or the yi- prefix): breast yímait, child yi-kána, fire yá'au [yaʔau], man yí-ka'am, moon wínü, not yú'u'un, sun wábiliu, tree lúwok, water sípil, woman yí-kaet / yíkaɛːt. These accent marks are the only prosodic notation known for the language; they suggest the original source (Laycock 1968) transcribed stress, but ten forms are not a rule statement.
